## Affordable alternative to Make.com
Boost.Space uses the Make.com engine, which makes automation powerful and reliable. The platform has a user-friendly GUI and a clear flowchart view that helps me easily see how everything connects. I run multiple workflows daily, and the generous limits make it very useful.  
  
The only challenge is that the app sync feature can be complex and has a steep learning curve at first.  
  
Overall, it’s a helpful and easy-to-use tool that saves me time and simplifies managing my tasks.
